name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.26.1: order rows now carry a date, not just a clock time. The activity tab's recent orders and the orders page both rendered createTime with fmtTimeS, so a purchase read as '14:22:07' with nothing saying which day - ambiguous the moment a list spans midnight, which the orders page (up to 100 rows) almost always does, and these rows get reconciled against Nayax days later. Both now use a new fmtDateTimeS. Seconds are kept because that is what matches a card transaction; the year is shown only when it is not the current one, so the common case stays short enough for the mobile card layout where this cell gets its own line. The helper guards falsy timestamps before parsing rather than only checking isNaN: new Date(null) and new Date(0) are the epoch, a valid date, so a missing createTime would otherwise have rendered as a confident '01 Jan 1970' instead of a dash. Frontend only. Cumulative over v6.26.
